```{r setup}
data5 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/experiment_5.csv"))

data <- rbind(data, data4)
data <- rbind(data, data5)
data <- rbind(data, data6)
```

```{r}
# Data manipulation
# 1. Rename Q values 
data <- data %>% rename(JC = q_value_pop2_JC)
data <- data %>% rename(JA = q_value_pop1_JA)

# 2. Set hybrid statuses
data <- data %>% mutate(
  hybrid_status = case_when (
    str_detect(ind_id, "IND") ~ str_split_i(ind_id, "_", 2),
    str_detect(ind_id, "F1") ~ "F1",
    str_detect(ind_id, "F2") ~ "F2",
    str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP1") ~ "B2_JC",
    str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP2") ~ "B2_JA",
    str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP1") ~ "B3_JC",
    str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP2") ~ "B3_JA"
  )
)

# # 3. Read data and set factor order
data <- data %>%
  mutate(hybrid_status = factor(
    hybrid_status,
    levels = c("JA","B3_JA", "B2_JA", "F1", "F2", "B2_JC", "B3_JC", "JC")
  ))

data <- data %>%
  mutate(experiment_ID = factor(
    experiment_ID
  ))
```

```{r}
# 3. Apply Grouped Swapping Logic (Values and Background Statuses)
data <- data %>%
  # Group strictly to isolate distinct runs and prevent data bleeding
  group_by(experiment_ID, bootstrap_ID, run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    # Identify reference types using your clean status strings
    is_ref_JA = (hybrid_status == "JA"),
    is_ref_JC = (hybrid_status == "JC"),
    
    # Check if this specific iteration flipped globally
    bootstrap_should_swap = any(
      (is_ref_JA & JA < JC) | 
      (is_ref_JC & JA > JC), 
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    # Cache original values for a non-destructive column swap
    orig_JA = JA,
    orig_JC = JC,
    orig_status = as.character(hybrid_status),
    
    # Conditionally invert numerical metrics for ALL individuals in the group
    JA = if_else(bootstrap_should_swap, orig_JC, orig_JA),
    JC = if_else(bootstrap_should_swap, orig_JA, orig_JC),
    
    # Conditionally invert structural hybrid labels to preserve alignment
    hybrid_status = if_else(
      bootstrap_should_swap,
      case_when(
        orig_status == "B2_JA" ~ "B2_JC",
        orig_status == "B2_JC" ~ "B2_JA",
        orig_status == "B3_JA" ~ "B3_JC",
        orig_status == "B3_JC" ~ "B3_JA",
        TRUE                   ~ orig_status  # F1 and F2 are symmetric; remain unchanged
      ),
      orig_status
    )
  ) %>%
  # Remove helper processing tracking columns
  select(-is_ref_JA, -is_ref_JC, -bootstrap_should_swap, -orig_JA, -orig_JC, -orig_status) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Combine both grouping variables inside a single group_by statement
summary_data <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, hybrid_status) %>%
  summarize(
    # mean_q_JA  = mean(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_q_JA    = sd(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_q_JC  = mean(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_q_JC    = sd(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_runs = n(),
    .groups    = "drop" # This automatically ungroups the data after summarizing
  )

print(summary_data)
```

```{r}
q_dist_plot <- ggplot(data, aes(experiment_ID, y = JC, fill = experiment_ID)) +
  # Draw boxplot to show median and IQR per experiment
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  # Overlay actual individual observations cleanly on top
  # geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.3) +
  # Separate panels by hybrid class
  facet_wrap(~ hybrid_status, ncol=3) +
  # Corrected Labels
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of SIMULATED Hybrid Status Across Experiments",
    x = "Experiment ID", # Fixed axis label to match data
    y = "Q-value (1-JC, 0-JA)"
  ) +
  # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    #legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(q_dist_plot)

ggsave(
    filename = "test.png",
    plot = q_dist_plot
)
```
